Stretcher: 1. "#0 x 36 St [St in circle] / 1/4 / [drawing of frame] basswood" (George Of, graphite) 2. "O #17" (unidentified hand, green crayon). Verso: "Georgia O'Keeffe – 1930" (white paint). Canvas edge: "Okeeffe" (Andrew Droth, black ink) 
(Source: Lynes, 1999)

cr_data.provenance: (An American Place, New York, NY); Mrs. Edgar L. Berkeley (Mrs. Louis Sosland), Kansas City, Missouri, 1933 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Inscription in museum file: "Apple Blossoms – 1930/(oil) by Georgia O'Keeffe" (Alfred Stieglitz, fragment of original backing, black ink). Whitney Archive (American Art Research Council Questionnaires) indicates, "Label on back states picture was painted in 1930, notes backing inscription and indicates No. 13 in An American Place 1931 exhibition." Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Bought from A.S." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, 1931 New York (An American Place) exhibition checklist.
titles.title: Apple Blossoms

description: Delicate white and pink apple blossoms with yellow centers dot the composition. Green leaves sit behind the blossoms. The foliage is complimented by a pale blue background.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art.
